description: Single storey side to rear extension;  Alterations to roof to form enlarged rear dormer, Roof lights in front roof slope (Demolition of attached garage and conservatory to rear)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Notwithstanding the drawings hereby approved, the proposed alterations to the existing patio, including its extension along the boundary shared with No. 46 Love Lane,</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"> shall be constructed in permeable porous materials and shall be maintained/retained thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</span></p>
